content.report: Implemented a tiny self-contained HTML page with one button that cycles the page background through a set of colors on click. The color logic is exposed on window so it can be exercised in a Node vm DOM fixture. Included a small set of builder tests using node:test and node:assert/strict with a minimal vm-based DOM stub (no external packages). Note: per instructions I have not executed the tests; test authorship and verification are the Tester's responsibility.
